correctness.rationale: Writing F_n=R∘M shows the rotating frame visits each site once in n clocks, flipping only isolated bits and never generating a new isolated bit. Thus the unique periodic set is no-isolated-bit cyclic words and τ≤n. Last entry at n occurs exactly when original site 0 remains isolated after the first n−1 visiting steps; the rightmost equal adjacent pair of interior bits and parity of its alternating suffix yield E_n=(2^(n−2)+2+2*1_{n odd})/3. The four-state adjacency-pair transfer matrix has characteristic factors (λ²−λ−1)(λ²−λ+1), giving the Lucas population and Möbius orbit census. Independent direct orbit enumeration in this execution verified E_n for all n=3..11 (5124+ states overall), an illustration rather than the universal proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Synchronous parallel Rule 232 has simultaneous updates and different maximal entry-time scale; its transfer matrix is not the rotating sequential map. General stable-state results do not count time-n transient inputs.
